formula: dx = radius_xy_mm * sin(J1_deg + delta_deg); dy = -radius_xy_mm * cos(J1_deg + delta_deg)
convention: tip_xy = TCP_xy + [dx, dy]; command TCP_xy via tcp_xy_from_tip (J1-consistent)
source: 50mm line fit P1/P2/P3/P4/P6/P7; delta_deg=6.15; radius=27mm XY
note: Do not change without recalibration. Runtime Inputdemo must use this file.
